episode_summary: This episode discusses the untapped potential of TikTok for real estate agents, emphasizing the 'empty stage method' to build a personal brand in a less crowded space. By answering real client questions and localizing content, agents can effectively reach a growing adult audience on TikTok. Consistency and authenticity are key to leveraging this platform for lead generation and brand visibility.
